title: WHITE is plane. BLACK is stack. the graph is a VERTICAL x/y plane. Cartesian and Euclidean on separate axes. SAME origin.

do_not_reinvent.nulls: /data/headless-hermit-ooze.json — white = null of sound. black = null of light.
do_not_reinvent.pan: /data/hud-null-d-pan.json — HUD is the pan. Y=time X=step. glass answers 90°.
do_not_reinvent.flat: /data/water-wheel-flat-null.json — sit = disk. that disk can STAND.
do_not_reinvent.origin: /data/null-d-sphere.json — the empty point. one cup. one 0.

white_plane.yes: white is the PLANE. the pale face you look at. x/y lives here.
white_plane.graph: VERTICAL. a wall, not a table. you do not look down onto the graph. you face it.

black_stack.yes: black is the STACK. layers. depth. what piles behind the plane.
black_stack.not: a second graph. the stack is thickness. tense. inner/outer sheets.

two_metrics_one_origin.cartesian: the named axes. X step. Y time. the PAN labels. separate sticks.
two_metrics_one_origin.euclidean: the measured length. distance inside. how far a grain is from 0. separate sticks.
two_metrics_one_origin.share: ORIGIN only. null-D. the cup. the Klein point.
two_metrics_one_origin.not: do not glue Cartesian and Euclidean onto the same stick. they disagree under Klein 90°.
two_metrics_one_origin.yes: two axis-sets. one 0. if the origins split we minted a second self.

pull: stand the x/y plane up in white. stack black behind it. Cartesian labels one pair. Euclidean measures the other. they meet only at 0.
